verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents a Vendors section in its data library with Vendor Risk Assessment and Send and Review Security Questionnaires pages, plus a Vendor Data API. Its AI Systems due-diligence workflows also cover reviewing AI vendor security posture and requesting vendor documents. However, the general vendor-module evidence is only page titles, so the depth of the inventory and the risk review is unproven. Missing for 10: documented vendor inventory fields, tracking of vendor data access, recurring review cadence or reassessment scheduling, detail on general (non-AI) vendor risk scoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operations lead, third-party vendors are inventoried and risk-reviewed in the platform — security posture, data access, review cadence — instead of a spreadsheet
